_comment: B2 spec/eval pilot (decisions/0011, 0037, 0073). Scoped to four pure catalog-backed validators: validateSecurityTxt, validateLlmsTxt, validateFeedJson, and validateFeedXml. Network-path plumbing remains bracketed with '// Stryker disable all' / '// Stryker restore all' comments. This keeps the score about the declared validators instead of diluting it with untested I/O. thresholds.break=70 is the historical raise-only floor. Known survivors are primarily message StringLiteral mutants, because {id, severity} pairs are the catalog contract. Raise thresholds.break as cases are added; do not lower it to make a regression pass.
_comment_plugins: REQUIRED under pnpm (atlas decision 0032). Stryker's default plugin discovery globs `@stryker-mutator/*` under the node_modules that contains @stryker-mutator/core -- under npm's flat tree that is the project root, where the vitest runner also sits, so discovery worked implicitly. pnpm's isolated layout puts core under node_modules/.pnpm/@stryker-mutator+core@<hash>/node_modules/, whose sibling @stryker-mutator/ directory holds only core's own deps, so the glob finds nothing and the run dies with 'Cannot find TestRunner plugin "vitest". In fact, no TestRunner plugins were loaded.' Naming the plugin explicitly resolves it from the project root instead of by glob. Do not remove.
_comment_llms_structure: scripts/audit/lib/llms-structure.mjs was the fourth entry here (143 mutants: 110 killed, 2 timeout, 31 survived, 78.32% on its own) until atlas decision 0079 item 4 wave 2b replaced the vendored copy with @j0nathan-ll0yd/estate-contracts. It is dropped rather than repointed: Stryker mutates a sandbox copy of the project and symlinks node_modules, so a mutate glob into a dependency is not supported and would write into the real install. THIS IS A REAL LOSS OF LOCAL SIGNAL AND IS NAMED, NOT HIDDEN -- the rule's mutation coverage is now atlas's to own. The rule is still behaviorally gated here by tests/audit/spec-cases.test.ts, validate-llms-txt.property.test.ts and llms-differential.test.ts, and by the spec-version assertion in llms-structure.integrity.test.ts; it is simply no longer mutation-scored here. Measured effect on the gate: 78.80% over four files becomes 79.11% over three, so thresholds.break stays at its historical 70 floor and is NOT lowered.
